tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | CI/CD, Production Reliability & Java
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, observability, operational readiness, and production troubleshooting. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with proven expertise in cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, database performance tuning, and collaborating within agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] The role owns the technical mechanisms for CI/CD, environments, observability, operational…
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in owning the technical mechanisms for CI/CD, environments, and production reliability for SAP Commerce platforms at your organization. With over 5 years of professional backend and e-commerce experience building and supporting enterprise solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in platform operations, deployments, and stability.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Environments
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and configuration management on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

bullets.label: Production Reliability & Support
bullets.text: Supported production troubleshooting, investigated and resolved complex integration bottlenecks, and engineered API migrations to improve system stability.

bullets.label: Backend & Integration Depth
bullets.text: Developed core SAP Hybris modules, customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters, and optimized backend functionality using Java and Spring.

bullets.label: Performance & Database Operations
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed across enterprise e-commerce systems.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my operational experience aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce platform experience and deep background in CI/CD deployment cycles, environment management, and production reliability to help your team maintain robust, high-performing enterprise systems. Your focus on operational excellence and platform reliability matches my hands-on expertise in supporting large-scale e-commerce infrastructures.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise in CI/CD execution, environment stability, and production reliability to drive robust e-commerce operations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce experience specializing in CI/CD deployments, CCv2 environments, and production reliability at Shell and Rockwell Automation, I would love to connect regarding your opening. I have a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: [Post] The role owns the technical mechanisms for CI/CD, environments, observability, operational… - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce position focusing on CI/CD, environments, and production reliability.

With over 5 years of professional experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring hands-on expertise in executing CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, managing platform environments, and ensuring production reliability.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available to start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
